newsitem.title: ITALY: Hundreds of children in Italy food poisoning scare.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds of children in Italy food poisoning scare.

text.p: Some 700 school children in the Turin area were treated in hospitals on Wednesday in what Italian health officials said was an outbreak of food poisoning.

They said the children, from eight kindergarten and elementary schools in the town of Moncalieri and five schools from the town of Giaveno, had all eaten food provided by the same supplier at lunch on Tuesday.
Police and health inspectors had gone to the company's kitchens to take samples of the food after many children complained of stomach pains, vomiting and fever.
One of the mayors of the town involved said none of the children was in a serious condition.
The food poisoning was believed to have been linked to a tuna and sweetcorn salad eaten in area schools on Tuesday.
The exact cause of the food poisoning was not known but it was believed to be caused by bacteria.
